svg.title: Integer fixing success rate against arc length
svg.desc: Carrier-phase integer ambiguity fixing between lunar surface stations and an orbiter, from the committed result of the scored run of engine v0.40.0 (tests/fixtures/lunar_infra/phase_full_run.json: 3 arc lengths, a Monte Carlo of 400 draws each, written by scenarios/carrier-phase-scored.toml). 1 day: success 1.0 % (standard error 0.5 %), 134 ambiguities, orbiter position sigma 45.6 m float and 18.5 m fixed; 2 day: success 0.5 % (standard error 0.4 %), 259 ambiguities, orbiter position sigma 21.5 m float and 8.7 m fixed; 3 day: success 2.8 % (standard error 0.8 %), 375 ambiguities, orbiter position sigma 6.3 m float and 2.1 m fixed. Integer fixing is not achieved: success stays between 1 % and 3 % at 25 dBi, and at the registered 12 dBi the problem cannot be formed. MODELLED: a restricted three-body model with stated simplifications and illustrative inputs, not a measurement of any lunar quantity. Advisory: analysis output from a research and engineering tool, not type-approved navigation equipment and not a safety-of-life service.
